title: Questions to ask before moving in together

slides.title: Questions to ask *before moving in* together
slides.sub: Unpack these before you unpack the boxes.

slides.label: Money
slides.text: How do we split the bills, and what *feels fair* to both of us?

slides.label: Chores
slides.text: Which chore do you *hate most*, and can we trade?

slides.label: Space
slides.text: How much *alone time* do you need at home?

slides.label: Guests
slides.text: How often can friends and family *stay over?*

slides.label: Mess
slides.text: What’s *your* idea of clean, and what’s mine?

slides.label: Future
slides.text: Is this a step toward *something bigger* for you?

slides.title: Save this *before you get the keys.*
slides.sub: Then open one box a night. Snacks help.
